refs/kitaev-2405.02434/approximate_algebras.tex:2780-2783 VERBATIM: "(See \eqref{Pauli_diag} for an explicit example.) The diagonal of the entire algebra $\calB$ is $D=\sum_{s}p_{s}\ts U_{s}^\dag\otimes U_{s}$, where $s=(s_1,\dots,s_m)$,
\begin{equation}
p_{s_1,\dots,s_m}=p_{1s_1}\cdots p_{ms_m},\qquad
U_{s_1,\dots,s_m}=U_{1s_1}\oplus\cdots\oplus U_{ms_m}.
\end{equation}" [PROVENANCE-ONLY: records the printed prescription; does not assert that it is a diagonal.]
